$comment: Gzip budget of the web app's first load, checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs after the web build (CI: Web build). Measured 2026-10-26: entry 296 KB, entry and its static imports 663 KB. Raised to 695 KB on 2026-10-30 for replan-the-day (the missed-block count and packer that Day, Week and Today need before the lazy preview). Raised to 700 KB (entry 313 KB) on 2026-10-30 for calendar-frames: the frame occurrences, the bands behind the Day and Week blocks and the Plan-from-a-frame placement are drawn with the grid (about 3 KB); the Frames dialog is lazy, and lazy bands cost more in shared-chunk overhead than they saved. Raised to 705 KB on 2026-10-30 for calendar-slots (measured 702.8 KB): the slot block with its checklist and details, the slot rows of the phone agenda, the slot start in every list row's time column (TaskRow) and the Schedule sheet's slot choices are drawn on first load (about 4 KB, as design D11 estimated); a lazy details popover measured the same 702.8 KB, so it stays static. Entry raised to 314 KB on 2026-10-30 for bento-daily-check (measured entry 313.1 KB, first load 703.7 KB): the Bento read (sizes, the reconciled slots and the Frog or Summit order) is needed by the Focus engine in the shell, the Loop home and the Daily focus rows of How you work; changing a Bento, the slot rows and the slot menu load with the review screens. Raised to 707 KB on 2026-10-30 for task-energy (measured first load 705.5 KB, entry 313.5 KB): the energy read and its word on every row (TaskRow), the ~deep token in the quick-add parser and its suggestions, the energy filter terms in the parser and evaluator, and the Energy fact, submenu and choice are needed where tasks are drawn and typed (about 1.8 KB, under the 2 KB design estimate); none of it is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raise only on purpose, with the reason in the pull request. Raised to 713 KB (entry 320 KB) on 2026-10-30 for calendar-clarity (measured first load 711.1 KB, entry 318.3 KB): deadline markers on Day, Week, Month and Plan, adding with the pointer (double-click, the add menu, the long press), Colour by for the calendar and boards, the calendar's and Upcoming's query filter with its chip, and the project Calendar layout are drawn with the views (about 5.6 KB against the 3 KB design estimate); the filter dialog is lazy, and a lazy project Calendar layout split ProjectHeader and the views into a shared chunk that measured 8 KB more. Raised to 715 KB (entry 321 KB) on 2026-10-30 for view-manual-order (measured first load 714.1 KB, entry 320.1 KB): the order read of label pages and saved views (lib/viewOrder) and their drag and Alt+arrow handling are drawn with those lists (TaskListView, SavedViewView, about 1.1 KB); the write and its Undo load with the first move. Raised to 716 KB on 2026-10-31 for phone-touch-focus (measured first load 715.4 KB, entry 319.6 KB): the Add to focus / Put in a slot / Remove from focus item of the task menus (the Actions menu, the task panel and page, the Focus screen) needs the focus state where those menus are drawn, and the picker host lives in the shell (about 1.3 KB with the Bento read, which moved out of the entry into the shared chunk); the rules, the writes and the picker load lazily with the first use. Raised to 717 KB on 2026-10-31 for notes-compaction (measured first load 716.4 KB, entry 320.4 KB): the Database storage card is lazy, but its settings copy and search entry (settingsCopy, settingsIndex, read by the settings search in the shell) and the History line that older note versions are kept one per day (task tab and project panel) are drawn on first load (about 0.4 KB). Raised to 718 KB on 2026-10-31 for notes-toolbar-desktop (measured first load 717.5 KB, entry 320.6 KB): the comment composer is part of the task page, which the shell loads statically, and its Formatting toggle now remembers its row on the device and reads the synced Formatting button setting; the toggle and its device state are one small chunk shared with the lazy note editor (0.9 KB with its imports), and the setting row and its search entry add about 0.2 KB. The roving-focus toolbar stays in the lazy editor chunk. Raised to 720 KB (entry 322 KB) on 2026-10-31 for notes-overview (measured first load 719.7 KB, entry 321.0 KB): the Notes page, its search index, the note panel, the snippets of the palette and the append fold are lazy, but the synced note entity (its table, row defaults and content-field rules), the receipt side of pending appends in the sync path, the notes filter terms in the parser and evaluator and their condition-dialog kind, the Notes sidebar entry and its promotion setting, the go and page shortcuts with their cheat-sheet copy, the palette commands and the Trash rows of notes, and the note icon are needed by the shell and the views that load with it (about 2.2 KB against the 1.5 KB design estimate; moving the fold into the lazy rich-text chunk saved 0.5 KB). Raised to 723 KB on 2026-10-31 for series-occurrences (measured first load 722.4 KB, entry 321.9 KB): Day, Week and Month load with the shell, so the projected block, row and agenda item, their selection and capacity share, the Month cell order with projections, the calendar menu switch and the panel's "Projected for" line are drawn on first load (about 2.7 KB against the 1.5 KB design estimate); the walk itself only moved from plan.ts, and Upcoming's projected rows and their math load lazily with Upcoming's switch, which is off by default. Raised to 727 KB (entry 323 KB) on 2026-10-31 for series-exceptions (measured first load 725.8 KB, entry 322.0 KB): completing and skipping a series now read its occurrence records (the exception dates, the done and open count and the jump over them, in recurring.ts and the shared walk), deleting an open occurrence writes its skip, the habit grid reads moved and open records, every projection carries its menu gestures and its drag (the right-click, the long press, Shift+F10) and the list row's repeat mark names its series (about 3.4 KB against the 4 to 5 KB design estimate); acting on a future occurrence (seriesPlan.ts), the projection menu and Move dialog, the panel's scope control and occurrence actions, and the repair after a pull load lazily on first use. Raised to 728 KB on 2026-10-31 for multi-day-tasks (measured first load 727.6 KB, entry 314.7 KB): Day, Week and Month load with the shell, so the span selection and lane packing, the span band's place in the Week header and Month's week rows, the trailing end of a date-only row, the span keys in the calendar scope, the range chip and the "until" chip on every list row (TaskRow) and the Upcoming and Today rules are drawn on first load (about 5.9 KB against the 4 KB design estimate); the bars themselves (SpanBand) and the drag (spanDrag) load lazily when a span is on screen, and Plan, the calendar's least used mode, now loads on first use (2.3 KB off the first load, 7 KB off the entry). Raised to 729 KB on 2026-10-31 for board-polish (measured first load 728.6 KB, entry 308.8 KB): folding a column is drawn with the boards that load with the shell (the project board, a saved view's board and the board of filters): the fold item of the column menu, the strip around a folded column that stays a drop target, the phone pager over unfolded columns, `z` and the keyboard move into a folded column with its announcement, the folded panel of a board of filters, and the Notes on cards switch and project menu item (about 1.8 KB against the 2 KB design estimate); the strip's button and the notes preview (its Markdown-to-text function and the card line) load lazily with the first fold or preview. Raised to 730 KB on 2026-10-31 for accent-colour (measured first load 729.1 KB, entry 310.8 KB): the custom accent is applied by the AppearanceProvider in the shell (reading the stored colour, the cached derived values and setting the four inline properties) and Settings, which loads with the shell, draws the Custom tile with its popover host (about 0.5 KB against the 0.3 KB design estimate for the boot path); the derivation (accentDerive, 5.4 KB raw) and the picker load lazily with the first custom accent or the first open of the picker. Raised to 731 KB on 2026-10-31 for outlook-calendar-sync (measured first load 730.3 KB, entry 312.0 KB): Settings loads with the shell, so the calendar sync panel's Microsoft client row and dialog (client id, tenant check, redirect address, the last refusal), Connect Microsoft and its sign-in results, the Outlook card line and the new reasons are drawn on first load (about 1 KB); everything else of the change is on the server. Raised to 732 KB on 2026-10-31 for obsidian-origin (measured first load 731.3 KB, entry 312.0 KB): the Obsidian note-link check, the chip's note icon, its same-page link and its Copy link menu, and the shell's obsidian-links hand-over are drawn with every task row and the panel (about 1 KB); the check must run on the device after decryption, so it cannot wait for a lazy chunk. Raised to 733 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-engine (measured first load 732.2 KB): the bell row of a routine notice, the Routine notices channel event, the toast's second action (a run's Undo), the run and undo API calls and the palette command line are drawn with the shell (about 0.6 KB); Run routine… with the step reader loads lazily on use. Raised to 736 KB on 2026-11-01 for theme-engine (measured first load 735.6 KB, entry 313.4 KB, 3.5 KB over main): the AppearanceProvider in the shell reads the theme of each side, keeps the resolved themes the boot script applied, writes their style sheet and device cache and follows the system scheme between the two sides (lib/theme/apply.ts, choice.ts and the token list, about 1.5 KB); Settings, which loads with the shell, draws the Theme row with its theme cards (ThemeList) and the accent row's From the theme state (about 1.2 KB); and the native shells' system-bars hand-over and the bar colour of each side are part of applying the appearance (about 0.8 KB). The derivation, the format validator, the contrast check and the theme documents load lazily, only when a side's theme is not OpenTodo's and its cached result is stale, so nobody on the OpenTodo themes loads them. Raised to 737 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-editor (first load grew 0.8 KB): the /routines route and its old /rules address, the editor's six keys in the shortcut registry (their cheat-sheet copy), the routine API calls (catalogue, draft test, runs, the Inbox card's route and dismiss), the manual trigger and the sidebar and palette labels are read by the shell (against the 0.5 KB design estimate); the page, the editor, the pickers, the previews, Add step and the run history are one lazy chunk (28.5 KB gzip with the page). With the Inbox card (routines-editor part 3) the Inbox reads whether the account has a routine and Settings draws the Hide successful runs row (about 0.5 KB); the card itself loads lazily. Raised to 738 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-ai-step (measured first load 737.2 KB, entry 313.9 KB): Settings, which loads with the shell, draws the assistant's routines consent row with its disclosure paragraph, the bell draws the routine_proposal row, and the shell's API module carries the proposal and AI usage calls and the review key of the shortcut registry (about 0.4 KB with the new step-table entries the catalogue reads); the AI cards, the AI settings, the Test question and the proposal review are in the lazy routines chunk. Raised to 740 KB on 2026-11-01 for theme-editor (measured first load 739.1 KB, 1.8 KB over main's 737.3 KB): the shell reads `user:` choices against the synced theme table and re-resolves a custom theme when its row changes (choice.ts, customStamp.ts), the router knows /settings/appearance/themes/<id> and its leave guard, the shortcut registry has the editor's three keys with their cheat-sheet copy, and the Theme row's cards take a menu and the Low contrast mark (ThemeList), about 0.7 KB; the rest is chunk overhead: the editor's primitives load lazily as one chunk (ui/themeKit.ts), and the overlay, Card and theme-choice modules they share with the first load now sit in shared chunks of their own (exporting them through the barrel unlazily measured 2 KB more). The editor (9.4 KB gzip with its preview), the primitives (2.6 KB), the VS Code importer (2.7 KB) and the derivation worker load only when used. Raised to 741 KB on 2026-11-01 for theme-instance-default (measured first load 740.1 KB, 0.8 KB over main's 739.3 KB): the shell resolves an empty side through the server's default and reads `instance:` choices against the server themes this device remembers (choice.ts, which now also holds that small store so the boot path stays one module; a separate module split the i18n chunk and measured 2.6 KB more), the AppearanceProvider re-resolves when they change, Settings draws the Default (Server default) card and the From this server line of a card (ThemeList), and the API module has the four theme calls. Reading the themes again (instanceSync.ts), the Branding card's theme controls (BrandingThemes, with the contrast check) and the derivation, now in a worker of its own at start, load lazily. Raised to 746 KB on 2026-11-01 for routines-ai-step's device runs (measured first load 745.0 KB, 4.4 KB over main's 740.6 KB, entry 312.3 KB): the relay worker in the shell gains the routines opt-in, its capabilities and the routine event with the running state and recent runs (lib/relay, about 1.2 KB), the API module the commit, fail, opt-in and encrypted-apply calls, the bell decrypts a device run's sealed notice, the error catalogue gains the device-run codes and Settings' copy the routines rows (about 1.5 KB together); the rest is shared-chunk overhead: the lazily loaded device planner and runner share small modules with the shell (focus, durations, the query tokenizer and parser, the error messages, the relay), which Rollup now splits into chunks of their own. The planner (lib/rules/run), the runner, the on-device AI call, the encrypted proposal review and the Settings panel load lazily. Raised to 747 KB on 2026-11-01 for app-icon-badge (measured first load 746.1 KB): the badge has to follow every change while the app runs, so the count, the Badging API calls and the stored counts for the service worker (lib/appBadge, AppBadgeSync beside the shell) load with it, and Settings, which loads with the shell, draws the App icon badge card with its copy and search entry (about 0.5 KB). Raised to 748 KB on 2026-11-02 for upcoming-start-with-today (measured first load 747.1 KB): Upcoming loads with the shell, so its Start with Today menu item, the synced preference read and the shared Today grouping it calls (lib/listGroups, lib/dayLists) are drawn on first load (about 0.3 KB); there is no screen of its own to load lazily. Raised to 749 KB on 2026-11-02 for task-list-width (measured first load 748.1 KB, 0.1 KB over): every list row's title is its own component with the Tooltip for a cut title, and one shared ResizeObserver (ui/useOverflowing) measures the titles; it is the row itself, so it cannot load lazily. Raised to 756 KB on 2026-11-02 for time-sectors (measured first load 754.3 KB with the whole change, 5.3 KB over 749): the sector rules (lib/sectors, a leaf module shared with the parser and the filter), their names (sectorNames) and the one-when clearing in mutateMany (sectorWrites) are read by every task row, the facets, the inline editor and quick add; the quick-add sector phrases are part of the six vocabularies; the filter terms join the parser and evaluator; the When popover's Sector segment, the palette command and the planning list's Time sectors groups are drawn with the task panel and the Calendar, which load with the shell (about 5 KB against the 4 KB design estimate). None of these is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raised to 757 KB on 2026-11-02 for reusable-lists (measured first load 756.5 KB): every quick add in a project asks whether the target is a reusable list (lib/reuseGate), the list model shows a reusable list's Got it group whatever the device preference, the shell schedules the duplicate collapse when a reusable list's open items change, the project menu has the List… item with its palette choices, and the activity reads a merged duplicate (about 2 KB with the title normalization they share); the matching, the reopen and its toast (app/reuseList), the List step with the aisle sections (ListModeStep), the collapse itself and the aisle vocabularies (one lazy JSON chunk per language) load only for a reusable list. Raised to 758 KB on 2026-11-02 for calendar-lane-on-phones (GitHub issue 775, measured first load 757.1 KB): Day and Week load with the shell, so the lane's fold header with its count, the device choice and the capped lane region (calendar/laneFold) are drawn with the grid (about 0.6 KB); they are part of the lane, not a screen to load lazily. Raised to 759 KB on 2026-11-02 for chore-rotation (measured first load 758.3 KB, about 1.3 KB over main): completing a task plans the next assignee of a rotating series wherever completion is planned (lib/rotation, read by recurring.ts), the task panel's Assignee editor offers Take turns… and both property layouts draw the Takes turns line, the row chip draws the rotate mark, and the bell words a turn; the rotation editor itself (the ordered list, the people picker, the group buttons) loads lazily on first use. Lowered to 138 KB (entry) and 662 KB (first load) on 2026-11-02 for lazy off-path screens (measured entry 136.9 KB, first load 660.8 KB after merging main): Calendar, Settings and Import load on demand behind the shared skeleton, which took the entry from about 323 KB to 137 KB; the lower budget keeps later changes from quietly eating that. Raised to 666 KB on 2026-11-02 for location-reminders (measured first load 665.1 KB, about 3 KB over main): the shell publisher hands the armed location reminders to a native shell with the geofences capability (lib/geofences: the armed rule, the linked place's point, the payload and the per-device switch, and the bridge's scheduleGeofences with the sign-out reset), the notification's Done address completes the task, and the task panel's reminder field, which loads with the shell, draws the At a place menu group and the location chip with its radius and Fires on your phone (about 2 KB against the 2 KB design estimate, the rest chunk overhead). The radius form and the Settings card load lazily with their first use. Raised to 668 KB on 2026-11-02 for performance-10k (measured first load 666.9 KB, 0.9 KB over): the sync loop now holds the shared live data during a long pull (liveSnapshot's hold and periodic read), buffers the activity of an exchange and writes it trimmed at its end (activity.ts), and marks four moments in the browser's own performance timeline (lib/perfMarks); all of it runs with every sync and every list, so none of it can load lazily. Raised to 670 KB on 2026-11-03 for list-rendering-at-scale (measured first load 668.9 KB, 1.9 KB over): the patched task snapshot (lib/taskSnapshot), the pending tick (lib/pendingDone), the progressive row limit and the sibling ARIA of the lists (ListGroups) replace work every list does on first load, so they load with it. Raised to 139 KB (entry) and 671 KB (first load) on 2026-11-03 for list-rendering-at-scale part 2 (measured entry 138.1 KB, first load 670.0 KB): the snapshots of projects, labels, views and memberships keep unchanged rows (keepRows in lib/localData, which the shell reads), the task snapshot keys its context, the workspace directory is compared before it is stored, and the shell's sidebar counts are deferred (about 0.3 KB); they are the reads every screen shares, so they load with the shell. Raised to 140 KB (entry) and 674 KB (first load) on 2026-11-03 for list-rendering-at-scale's incremental list updates (measured entry 139.4 KB, first load 672.9 KB, 1.9 KB over): the kept rows and groups and the per-row comparison of the lists (listGroups, ListGroups), the flow state worked out when asked (lib/flow), cut titles measured only where drawn (ui/useOverflowing), the row height estimate, the counts that follow the tasks once the writes stop (lib/useSettledValue, read by the sidebar, the workspaces and the app badge) and the command bar's idle warm-up trigger in the shell replace work every list and the shell do on first load, so they load with them; the warm-up itself (PaletteWarmer) is a lazy chunk. Raised to 675 KB on 2026-11-03 for phone-interaction (measured first load 674.3 KB): Back closes overlays (useBackToClose and the router's hold while a closed overlay's Back lands), the phone drawer as an overlay with its inert and aria-hidden states, the stamped task-page entry and Select mode's tap on a row are part of the shell and every row (about 0.6 KB). Entry raised to 141 KB on 2026-11-03 for assistant-suggest-after-add (measured entry 140.01 KB, first load 674.8 KB): every quick add goes through createTaskThenSuggest, which checks the per-device switch and whether the assistant is busy before it asks, so the check sits on the add path in the entry chunk; the panel and the turn load lazily as before. Raised to 676 KB on 2026-11-03 for custom-field-sort (measured first load 675.3 KB after #754 and #758): ordering by a Number or Date custom field is part of every list's comparator (compareTasks with its cached field values, the id parse and read in lib/types, the Order by menu's Custom fields group), so it draws with the lists and cannot load lazily (about 0.5 KB). Raised to 142 KB (entry) and 677 KB (first load) on 2026-11-03 for accessibility-aa (measured entry 140.8 KB, first load 676.2 KB, 0.4 KB over main): what keeps every screen usable from the keyboard and a screen reader runs from the first screen: the focus clearance installed at start (lib/focusClearance), the inert page behind a modal dialog or sheet (ui/overlay/stack), each toast region keeping clear of the focus (ui/overlay/Toasts) and the menu item's ring; none of it is a screen to load lazily. Raised to 678 KB on 2026-11-03 for bulk-menu-after-empty-list (measured first load 677.1 KB on main after #849): the Actions menu's open state per target (useActionsOpen) and the side panel's and the Inbox split's check that the cursor's row is still listed run with every list, so they draw with the shell. Raised to 679 KB on 2026-11-03 for the subtask path (measured first load 678.2 KB, 0.2 KB over): the path is the header of the task page and the docked panel, which load with the shell, so the crumbs, the folded-parent menu and the two parent shortcuts are drawn on first load. There is no screen of its own to load lazily. Raised to 680 KB on 2026-11-04 for mcp-oauth (measured first load 679.4 KB, 0.5 KB over): the shell takes a pending OAuth consent request out of the address before the router touches it (OAuthConsentHost), the API module carries the consent calls and the error catalogue the client routes' codes; the consent dialog itself loads lazily, only when the app is opened with one. Raised to 681 KB on 2026-11-04 for the Inbox process title (GitHub issue 858, measured 679.8 KB on the build before mcp-oauth, about 0.8 KB): the card's title is the same field as the panel's, so a voice-to-text line can be corrected without leaving the mode and a token is read the same way; the process screen loads on demand, and sharing the field with the panel pulled it into a chunk the first load already shares. With mcp-oauth in the same first load the budget is 681 KB. Raised to 143 KB (entry) and 682 KB (first load) on 2026-11-04 for calendar events in Upcoming (measured entry 142.6 KB, first load 681.8 KB): Upcoming loads with the shell, so the per-day agenda, the synced preference and the headings for days that only have meetings are drawn on first load (about 0.8 KB); the event rows are the ones Today already draws. Raised to 683 KB on 2026-11-04 for simplified-chinese (measured first load 682.0 KB, a fraction over 682, entry 142.6 KB): the shell lists 简体中文, matches zh, zh-Hans, zh-CN and zh-SG without treating zh-TW as Simplified, and the digest picker includes it. The catalog itself is a lazy chunk (about 183 KB gzip) and is not part of the first load. Raised to 144 KB (entry) and 684 KB (first load) on 2026-11-05 for today-assigned-filter (PR 900, measured entry 143.1 KB, first load 683.8 KB, about 0.8 KB over): Today, the sidebar counts and the app badge, which load with the shell, read the synced preference that hides tasks assigned to others, and the filter parser, evaluator and condition editor gain its term, so it is drawn where those load and cannot wait for a lazy chunk. The change merged without raising the budget, which left main's Web build red; brand-mark-tray (PR 902) added nothing measurable. Lowered to 137 KB (entry) and 678 KB (first load) on 2026-11-06 (measured entry 135.2 KB, first load 676.2 KB, from 684.1 KB that left main red after ordinal-weekday and the scale fixes for issue 854): the second-factor enrolment QR code and its encoder (qrcode-generator, about 8 KB gzip) were in the entry because the shell imports TwoFactorPanel for the enrolment gate; the QR code is now its own module (app/QrCode.tsx) that the wizard loads when it opens, behind a square of the same size. The lower budget keeps about 1.8 KB of headroom for the changes in flight. Raised to 679 KB on 2026-11-06 for accessibility-aa's drag alternatives (measured first load 678.6 KB, about 1.3 KB of it this change): every drag gets a one-pointer way where it is drawn: the Reorder submenu of a task's menu with its list context (bulk/BulkActions, read by the lists and saved views), the move handle on rotation, frame and objective rows (ui/MoveHandle) and the click on the sidebar and panel resizers; they are part of the menus and rows that load with the shell, so none can load lazily. Raised to 680 KB on 2026-11-06 for import-origin-reads-as-app (GitHub issue 945, measured first load 679.3 KB after the drag alternatives, entry 136.3 KB; about 0.7 KB of it this change): an imported origin reads as its app on every row, card, panel and history line, so the app-name table (importApp, beside the origin readers every row uses) and the words "Imported from <app>" (lib/originText, kept apart from lib/taskOrigin so the translations stay out of the entry chunk; importing them there put i18n in the entry, 212 KB) load with the rows; there is no screen of its own to load lazily. Raised to 681 KB on 2026-11-06 for the MCP OAuth connector redirects (PR 972, measured first load 680.1 KB, 0.1 KB over): the assistant catalogue (lib/assistants, read by the shell's API module and the consent host) gains the ChatGPT and Claude connector redirect prefixes and the custom-redirect check, and the error catalogue the new redirect code; they sit with the consent host that the shell loads, so they cannot load lazily. Raised to 140 KB (entry) and 685 KB (first load) on 2026-11-07 for incremental-list-updates (measured entry 139.1 KB, first load 684.8 KB, from 137.0 and 680.3 on main): what every list, count and badge derives from the tasks is now worked out from the rows each write changed, so the change links of the task snapshot (lib/taskDelta, with its layered task index), the patches beside each derivation (the visible sets, open tasks and counts, progress, blockers, habits, the flow state, a view's tasks, the tree split and buckets, completed by section, the Today closed list's done tasks, the badge counts) and the sidebar's counts (lib/sidebarCounts) run on the first write after start and with every list; they replace work those lists do on first load, so they cannot wait for a lazy chunk. Raised to 686 KB on 2026-11-07 for fix-recurring-tracked-time (GitHub issue 1004, measured first load 685.3 KB, 0.5 KB over main's 684.8 KB, entry 139.1 KB): every row's tracked chip, the filter and the sidebar counts read one shared total that now counts a repeating task's current occurrence, so the occurrence start (occurrenceStarts in lib/time, reading the series' records) and the totals store's subscription to the task snapshot run with every list, and the task panel, which loads with the shell, draws the Time tab's All occurrences line; none of it is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raised to 687 KB on 2026-11-07 for quick-add-weekday-recurrence (GitHub issue 1016, measured first load 686.1 KB, 0.1 KB over): the recurrence grammar's `every N weeks on <weekdays>` with its week phase (lib/recurrence, read by every series' completion and the habit grid) and the quick-add parser's start phrases, connectors and week-on words in the six vocabularies run with quick add and every list; neither is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raised to 688 KB on 2026-11-07 for tracked-time-api-compatible (measured first load 687.03 KB, 0.03 KB over): the filter's `tracked occurrence` term in the parser and evaluator and a second map in the shared tracked totals (every entry for filters, saved views and sidebar counts as in 1.0, the current occurrence for rows) run with every list; neither is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raised to 689 KB on 2026-11-08 for signed-web-app (main measured 687.8 KB): the page's update listener for the worker's ready and refused messages and the hook that loads the page's own branding (the worker serves the signed index.html unchanged); the branding code, the refusal banner and the About row are lazy, and the verifier lives in sw.js, which the budget does not measure. Entry raised to 141 KB on 2026-11-08 for drop-depth (GitHub issue 1037, measured entry 140.3 KB, first load 688.6 KB within 689 KB): the level of a drop between two rows of a tree list (task-list/dropDepth.ts: the gap's depths, the sideways step and the placement after the ancestor at that level) runs on every pointer move of a list drag, and the list's drag code is in the entry with TaskListView; loading it at the press would leave the first moves of a drag without a level. Raised to 690 KB on 2026-11-08 for add-below (GitHub issue 1036, measured first load 689.5 KB, 0.9 KB over drop-depth's 688.6 KB, entry 140.8 KB): the row menu's Add task below and Add subtask items, the list state that opens either inline line and where the Add task below line is drawn (task-list/belowLine.ts) run with every list; the line itself and its write (SiblingInput, lib/createAfter) load when it first opens.
